data.body: PLAN_AMENDMENT: Holdout partition test should validate the hash algorithm. Add test_holdout_partition_uses_md5_algorithm: for each tid in holdout.txt, confirm that int(hashlib.md5(tid.encode()).hexdigest()[0:8], 16) % 3 == 0. This validates T6b used the correct deterministic hash function, not Python built-in hash() which is PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent. Use a Python one-liner or awk within the bash test: python3 -c "import hashlib,sys; [print(l.strip()) for l in sys.stdin if int(hashlib.md5(l.strip().encode()).hexdigest()[0:8],16)%3!=0]" < holdout.txt. If any ticket_id prints, assert fails.
